description: Pad-number -> pin-name identity for the non-FPGA ICs of the Rev.0 analog/host chain. This is the schematic-freeze counterpart of pin-plan.json (which freezes the ECP5 BG256 ball identity). Every entry must name the manufacturer document it was taken from; scripts/verify-ic-pinouts.ts refuses a release build while a populated part has no source.

status.pending_scope: pad-number-to-pin-name mapping not yet cross-checked against the manufacturer pinout; the functional net names in the TSX are the documented signal topology only. Tracked in hardware/tscircuit/README.md -> 'Schematic-freeze status (Rev.0)'.

pending_findings.U_ADCLDO: LT3042EMSE#PBF is a 10-lead MSOP (MSE) + exposed GND pad, not a DFN. Datasheet pin map is 1 IN, 2 IN, 3 EN/UV, 4 PG, 5 ILIM, 6 PGFB, 7 SET, 8 GND, 9 OUTS, 10 OUT, pad GND. The TSX currently uses footprint dfn10 with an invented 1 OUT/2 SENSE/3 SET/4 ILIM/5 IN/6 EN_UV/7 PG/8 GND/9 OUT2/10 PGND map and ties ILIM to SET, which shorts the current-limit set input to the 100 uA voltage-set node.
pending_findings.U_ADC: LTC1407AIMSE-1#PBF is a 10-lead MSOP (MSE) + exposed GND pad. Datasheet pin map is 1 CH0+, 2 CH0-, 3 VREF, 4 CH1+, 5 CH1-, 6 GND, 7 VDD, 8 SDO, 9 SCK, 10 CONV, pad GND. The TSX currently has 3 CH1_PLUS, 4 CH1_MINUS, 5 VREF, 6 VDD, 7 GND, 8 CONV, 9 SCK, 10 SDO.
pending_findings.U_CLK: SiT5356 is a 10-pad 5.0 x 3.2 mm part, not a 4-pad DFN. Datasheet pin map is 1 OE/VC/NC, 2 SCL/NC, 3 NC, 4 GND, 5 A0/NC, 6 CLK, 7 NC, 8 NC, 9 VDD, 10 SDA/NC. Footprint dfn4 and the 4-pin map are wrong.
pending_findings.U_CLKLDO: TPS7A2033PDQNR is the 4-pin X2SON (DQN) option: 1 OUT, 2 GND, 3 EN, 4 IN, 5 thermal pad -> GND. The TSX uses the SOT-23-5 (DBV) map and footprint; DQN and DBV are different packages in the same family.
pending_findings.U_AUXLDO: TPS7A2025PDQNR is the 4-pin X2SON (DQN) option: 1 OUT, 2 GND, 3 EN, 4 IN, 5 thermal pad -> GND. Same DQN/DBV mismatch as U_CLKLDO.
pending_findings.U_CORE: TPS628502DRLR is an 8-pin SOT-583 (DRL) part. Datasheet pin map is 1 VIN, 2 EN, 3 MODE/SYNC, 4 COMP/FSET, 5 FB, 6 PG, 7 SW, 8 GND. The TSX uses footprint sot563 (6 pads) with an invented VIN/GND/SW/FB/COMP_FSET/MODE_SYNC/EN/VOS ordering; there is no VOS pin and EN is on pin 2, not pin 7.
pending_findings.DS1: NHD-C0220BiZ-FSW-FBW-3V3M has an 8-pin interface: 1 RST, 2 SCL, 3 SDA, 4 VSS, 5 VDD, 6 VOUT, 7 C1+, 8 C1-, plus a separate 2-pin backlight connector. The TSX models 7 pads (VDD/GND/SDA/SCL/RST/LED_A/LED_K) and is missing the charge-pump VOUT/C1+ C1- pins.
pending_findings.U_PPS: no orderable MPN is frozen anywhere in the design (docs/27 only fixes the PPS_REF ball and the output path), so its pad identity cannot be audited yet.

U_BPF.device: LTC1562 / LTC1562A quad universal continuous-time filter
notes: Pins 4, 7, 14 and 17 are substrate/shield connections internally tied to V_MINUS (pin 16) and must be soldered to the same point as pin 16.
Each 2nd-order section is a 3-terminal block: summing node INVx, bandpass output V1x, lowpass output V2x.
Figure 3 / Figure 6a wiring: ZIN (RINx) drives INVx from the source, RQx returns V1x to INVx, R2x returns V2x to INVx. The bandpass output of the cascade is V1x, not V2x.
Single supply: SHDN must be pulled to V_MINUS, never to AGND.
AGND (pin 15) is an internally generated V+/2 reference with ~7 kOhm source impedance; bypass it locally with >= 1 uF.

source.retrieval_method: text proxy (analog.com is unreachable from the build host)
source.retrieved_artifact_kind: plain-text conversion of the 1562fa data sheet
source.evidence: G PACKAGE 20-LEAD PLASTIC SSOP pin configuration table, plus the page-1 typical-application schematic (which omits pins 4, 7, 14, 17 because they are substrate connections)

notes: The GN-16 pinout is NOT the same as the UE12 (12-lead DFN) pinout: on the DFN the package is 1 INA / 2 AGND / 3 INB / 4 CS/LD / 5 DIN / 6 CLK / 7 DOUT / 8 DGND / 9 V+ / 10 OUTB / 11 V- / 12 OUTA with the exposed pad on V-.
Hardware shutdown is available on the GN-16 package only; SHDN is active high and a floating pin defaults to shutdown, so it must be tied to V_MINUS (or 0 V) for normal operation.
Only channel A is populated in Rev.0; INB/OUTB and DOUT stay open.

source.evidence: package/order-information page 2 pin configuration tables (UE12 and GN side by side) and the page-1 typical application 'A Dual, Matched Low Noise PGA (16-Lead SSOP Package)' schematic

U_BUF.device: OPA810 unity-gain-stable JFET-input voltage-feedback op amp
notes: DBV (SOT-23-5) is not the D (SOIC-8) pinout: the SOIC is 1/5/8 NC, 2 VIN-, 3 VIN+, 4 VS-, 6 VO, 7 VS+. On the DBV the five pads are 1 VO, 2 VS-, 3 VIN+, 4 VIN-, 5 VS+.
The part is a single op amp; only the DBV column of Table 5-1 applies to the frozen OPN.
Rev.0 uses it single-supply from 5V_AFE as a follower on the antenna node; V_MINUS is the negative supply and is tied to GND.

source.evidence: Section 5 Pin Configuration and Functions, Figure 5-2 'DBV Package, 5-Pin SOT23 and DCK Package, 5-Pin SC70 (Top View)' plus Table 5-1 Pin Functions DBV column (VO=1, VIN-=4, VIN+=3, VS-=2, VS+=5)

U_DRV.device: OPA2835 dual-channel, ultra-low-power, rail-to-rail output, negative-rail input voltage-feedback op amp
notes: IDGSR is the 10-pin VSSOP (DGS) orderable. The 8-pin SOIC (D) has no PD pins and the QFN/UQFN (RUN/RMC) packages move VS- to pin 5 and PD1 to pin 4.

PD1 (pin 5) and PD2 (pin 6) are active-high shutdown inputs and the data sheet states the pin MUST BE DRIVEN. A floating PD pin is not a valid operating condition, so both are tied to V_PLUS (3V3_ADC_A) for always-on operation.
Channel A is the signal driver and channel B the ADC common-mode buffer, both wired as unity-gain followers.

source.document: OPA835, OPA2835 data sheet, SLOS713J (REVISED MARCH 2021)
source.evidence: Figure 6-3 'OPA2835: DGS Package 10-Pin VSSOP Top View' (1 VOUT1, 2 VIN1-, 3 VIN1+, 4 VS-, 5 PD1, 6 PD2, 7 VIN2+, 8 VIN2-, 9 VOUT2, 10 VS+) cross-checked against Table 6-1 Pin Functions VSSOP column

U_SW.device: TPS22975N 5.7 V, 6 A, 16 mOhm on-resistance load switch without quick-output discharge
U_SW.package: DSG package, 8-pin WSON with exposed thermal pad
notes: DSG (WSON-8) is not a 6-pin SOT-23: the switch input is split across pins 1 and 2, the output across pins 7 and 8, and the exposed centre pad must be tied to GND.
The 'N' variant has no quick-output-discharge FET, which is why it is used here: when PI_3V3 disappears the switch turns off without pulling 5V_SYS down through a discharge device.
ON is active high and must not float; VBIAS is the device bias supply, not the switch input.

source.evidence: Section 6 Pin Configuration and Functions, 'DSG Package 8-Pin (WSON) Top View' (1 VIN, 2 VIN, 3 ON, 4 VBIAS, 5 GND, 6 CT, 7 VOUT, 8 VOUT) plus the Pin Functions table (pin 5 GND, pin 6 CT, pins 1/2 VIN, pins 7/8 VOUT, exposed thermal pad -> GND)

U_FLASH.device: W25Q64JV 64 Mbit serial NOR flash, standard/dual/quad SPI
notes: The 208-mil SOIC (SS) pad map is the frozen one; the 300-mil SOIC, WSON and XSON packages share the same pad order but the land pattern differs.
Rev.0 boots the ECP5 in single-bit Master SPI, so IO2 and IO3 keep their /WP and /HOLD functions and are pulled high through 10 kOhm.

source.evidence: Section 3.1 'Pin Configuration SOIC 208-mil' (Figure 1a, package code SS) with Section 3.3 'Pin Description SOIC 208-mil': 1 /CS, 2 DO (IO1), 3 /WP (IO2), 4 GND, 5 DI (IO0), 6 CLK, 7 /HOLD or /RESET (IO3), 8 VCC

U_EE.device: CAT24C32 32-Kb I2C serial CMOS EEPROM used as the HAT+ ID EEPROM
notes: This freezes the exact orderable MPN that docs/references.md previously listed only as a 'CAT24C32-compatible family' candidate; the SOIC-8 W-suffix pin map above is the one wired in the schematic.
A0/A1/A2 are hard-wired to VSS so the device answers at slave address 0x50, the HAT+ ID EEPROM address.
WP is pulled high through 1 kOhm; the ID bus is supplied from PI_3V3 and never reaches the ECP5.
The UDFN (HU4) option has a different land pattern and no WP pin on the WLCSP 4-ball option, so the package suffix is part of the identity.

source.document: CAT24C32 data sheet (32-Kb I2C CMOS Serial EEPROM), onsemi
source.evidence: Page-2 'PIN CONFIGURATIONS (Top Views)' drawing for 'PDIP (L), SOIC (W), TSSOP (Y), US (US), UDFN (HU4)': left 1 A0, 2 A1, 3 A2, 4 VSS; right 8 VCC, 7 WP, 6 SCL, 5 SDA; plus the 'PIN DESCRIPTION' section

LCD_BLQ.device: BSS138 logic-level N-channel MOSFET, LCD backlight low-side switch
notes: SOT-23 pin 1 is the gate, pin 2 the source and pin 3 the drain, which is the order the backlight low-side switch wiring assumes.
The gate is driven from 3V3_D through RBL2 and held low by RBL3 so the backlight is OFF while the ECP5 is unconfigured or in reset.
VGS(th) is 0.8/1.3/1.5 V, so the 3.3 V gate rail fully enhances the device at the 28 mA backlight current.

source.document: BSS138 data sheet (N-channel logic level MOSFET), onsemi
